included: Academic-calendar / aid-disbursement term modeling (manual/guided setup) — RICE 130.7; highest-value P0, structural anchor that makes runway math meaningful; manual/guided entry avoids risk-heavy SIS/bank dependency for v1
Refund-pacing runway engine — RICE 113.4; core problem-solving compute layer ('how long does my aid last') that depends on the term model above
Ambient one-number surface (low-touch) — RICE 108.0; primary UI surface and persona's core interaction, low-touch keeps build cost down while validating the 'one number' value hypothesis
excluded: Passive bank-transaction ingestion + auto-classification (P0, RICE 72.0) — EXCLUDED v1: highest technical/compliance risk (Plaid-style aggregation), not required to validate core runway value prop which can run on manual/guided input first; sequence into v1.1 once demand proven
Institutional SSO onboarding (P1, RICE 54.0) — EXCLUDED: institutional sales motion, not needed for direct-to-student learning launch
SOC2 compliance (P1, RICE 42.0) — EXCLUDED from MVP build, flagged as gating prerequisite the moment bank ingestion or institutional distribution is pursued
Predictive shortfall alerts (P1, RICE 76.8) — EXCLUDED: depends on trustworthy runway signal being validated first; premature alerts erode trust
Subscription detection (P1, RICE 61.3) — EXCLUDED: depends on transaction ingestion which is out of v1
All P2 items (literacy scaffolding, institutional analytics dashboard, multi-refund modeling, SIS integration, Student Plus tier depth) — EXCLUDED: post-MVP by definition
Expense splitting — EXCLUDED (explicitly deferred upstream): Splitwise owns the category and bundle demand is unconfirmed

findings.estimatedTimeline: ESTIMATE ONLY — PENDING FOUNDER/HUMAN APPROVAL, NOT A COMMITMENT: a rough order-of-magnitude of ~8-12 weeks appears feasible for the three included features (term model + runway engine + ambient one-number surface) given manual/guided input avoids bank/compliance work. Requires explicit human approval before treated as a delivery date; per upstream constraint no hard deadline is being attached.
launchCriteria: Primary persona (student on financial aid) can complete guided term/aid-disbursement setup in one session without support intervention (target: >=80% setup-completion rate in usability testing)
Runway engine produces a runway/one-number output for every completed setup with zero unhandled-error states across tested aid-disbursement patterns
The ambient one-number surface renders the runway figure as primary view, reachable in <=2 taps from app open
Every included feature emits instrumentation events before launch (no dark features shipping without telemetry)
Manual/guided term model correctly handles disbursement schedules of the target institution set used for pilot cohort (validated against real academic calendars)
A defined pilot cohort (target: N students recruited) is provisioned and consented for data collection
learningExperiments: Value hypothesis: does a single 'runway' number change how students perceive/manage aid — measure whether users return to check the number and whether self-reported confidence improves

Input-friction hypothesis: will students tolerate manual/guided term + aid setup, or is passive bank ingestion actually a hard requirement — measure setup completion and drop-off; de-risks decision to build excluded bank-ingestion feature
Accuracy-trust hypothesis: does runway figure match students' lived reality closely enough to be trusted — collect perceived-accuracy feedback vs actual spend
Persona-fit hypothesis: is aid-disbursement/refund-pacing framing the right core problem for the primary student persona vs general expense tracking
Demand signal for deferred bundle: passively observe whether users request expense-splitting or subscription features, to test upstream 'unconfirmed bundle demand' assumption without building it
instrumentationPlan: Activation funnel from day 1: install -> setup started -> term model completed -> first runway number viewed (measures onboarding friction and manual-input hypothesis)
Engagement: runway-surface open events, frequency/recency of return visits, time-to-first-open after disbursement events (measures ambient one-number value hypothesis)
Accuracy/trust telemetry: in-app perceived-accuracy prompt and any user corrections to runway inputs
Feature-request/intent capture: lightweight in-app signal for requested-but-excluded capabilities (bank sync, subscription detection, splitting) to quantify latent demand
Error/degradation logging: unhandled states, setup abandonment points, graceful-degradation fallbacks triggered (feeds launch-criteria and reliability)
Cohort-level retention: D1/D7/D30 retention and per-term retention aligned to disbursement cycles
